rules.text: **MUST.** Each iteration change set MUST be computed from deterministic before-and-after snapshots rather than accepted from an agent declaration.
**MUST.** Every authoritative file change MUST match both the active route authority set and its declared artifact patterns and constraints.
**MUST.** A hand edit to generated render or evidence output MUST be reported as a blocking scope violation.
**MUST.** A composite authoring route MUST apply only the current child route write scope and MUST NOT grant a broad union scope.

card.summary: Defines deterministic before-and-after file evidence, route write scopes, authority constraints, and generated-output edit detection for each agent iteration.
card.title: Authoring Change-Set Contract 1
